title: Authorize clean-room redelivery after forbidden private-path evidence finding
objective: Create and verify governance artifacts that mark legacy PR #19 RED because committed evidence contains a private absolute path, permanently prohibit that PR from entering main or being history-rewritten, and authorize a separately implemented clean-room redelivery task from the post-governance main branch without modifying product code, Harness runtime, or PR #19. Run npm run harness:doctor as a required baseline diagnostic, not a pass/fail acceptance gate, because this task exists to authorize repair of the pre-existing forbidden-path issue that currently makes the doctor fail on main; the governance write set forbids modifying the doctor runtime, harness/config/project.json, or the three existing forbidden tracked wallet artifacts.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify product code, Harness runtime, tests, package metadata, or project configuration.
Do not modify, close, ready, merge, squash, rebase, force-push, or rewrite history for PR #19.
Do not copy or cherry-pick PR #19 commits, code, evidence, or report text into a future delivery.
Do not create or implement the authorized clean-room Delivery Task in this governance task.
Do not use real local absolute paths, usernames, drive letters, credentials, raw provider payloads, or plaintext addresses in Git artifacts.
Do not run network, provider, wallet, or live-chain operations.
Do not modify the Harness Doctor runtime, harness/config/project.json, or the three existing forbidden tracked wallet artifacts.
